subject: Audit evidence: signed snapshots, query recipes, and handoff checklist
messages:
From: security-reviewer@acmehealth.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: compliance_ops@acmehealth.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Audit evidence request — admin activity and log exports

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intake last week. For our upcoming SIG/SOC2 evidence review we need a reproducible package of admin activity and audit logs covering the period 2027-04-01 -> 2027-05-31. Specifically we need:

- A manifest listing the exported files and their SHA256 hashes.
- Signed snapshots (detached signature) of the log bundle.
- Export schema / example records (NDJSON preferred).
- Query recipes for reproducing each evidence slice (time ranges, filters by actor and action).
- Chain-of-custody notes (who pulled, verification checksums, transport mechanism).

Can you confirm you can deliver the bundle and manifest by EOD 2027-06-02? Also let us know the retention cutoffs and whether any admin actions are only visible in a separate operator trail.

Thanks,
Sam H.
Security Reviewer
Acme Health
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: security-reviewer@acmehealth.com
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit evidence request — admin activity and log exports

Sam,

We can produce a reproducible evidence bundle by your requested cutoff. High-level plan (deliver by EOD 2027-06-02):

1) Evidence bundle: a single tarball containing NDJSON logs + manifest + detached signature file.
2) Manifest: JSON listing file names, sizes, SHA256 checksums, and a short description of each file.
3) Signature: PGP detached signature (signed with our audit key) plus a notarized digest (SHA256).
4) Query recipes: documented show/where queries (timestamp range, actor_id, action_type) and sample results (first/last 10).
5) Chain-of-custody: who created the export, the S3 presigned URL TTL, and how we transferred to you (S3 -> direct download).

Attachments: audit-manifest-v1.json (draft), export-playbook.pdf (runbook).

Notes and immediate answers to your questions:
- Retention: admin activity events are kept 18 months in cold store; operator trail (detailed console UI events) kept 12 months.
- Operator trail: visible in a separate export (operator-trail-YYYYMMDD.ndjson) — we'll include it in the bundle as an explicitly named file.

I'll let Dev add the technical export recipe.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: security-reviewer@acmehealth.com, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit evidence request — export schema and query recipes

Sam / team — technical details and reproducible steps below. I will execute the export tomorrow and drop the signed tarball.

What we log (summary):
- auth.login, auth.logout, auth.failed (console + API)
- admin.create_user, admin.update_user, admin.delete_user
- role.grant, role.revoke
- model.deploy, model.rollback, model.version_pin
- config.change (including key rotation events)
- kvcache.purge, kvcache.invalidate (useful for inference determinism checks)
- sys.kms_access, sys.kms_rotate
- infra.scale_up, infra.scale_down (instance/pool changes)
- request.infer (model_id, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, latency_ms) — sanitized; no prompt content in hosted exports unless customer consented

Record format: NDJSON, fields (tabular):
- timestamp_utc (ISO8601)
- request_id (uuid)
- actor_id (internal_user_id or service_account)
- actor_email (nullable)
- action (string)
- resource_type (e.g., project, model, key)
- resource_id
- outcome (success | failure)
- ip_address (ipv4/ipv6 or "-" for internal-only)
- client (console | api | internal-service)
- meta (short string: e.g., "old_role=reader new_role=editor")

Sample NDJSON line:
2027-04-01T14:32:21.123Z {"request_id":"f9a1c2d3-...","actor_id":"dev_patel","action":"role.grant","resource_type":"project","resource_id":"proj-224","outcome":"success","ip_address":"18.205.33.12","client":"console","meta":"old_role=reader new_role=editor"}

Export & signing steps we will perform:
1) Run export job (time-bounded) that writes NDJSON files to a hardened S3 bucket (s3://redwood-audit-exports/acme/2027-05-31/).
2) Generate manifest (audit-manifest-v1.json) listing SHA256 for each file.
3) Create a tarball: signed-snapshot-20270530.tar.gz and create detached signature signed-snapshot-20270530.tar.gz.sig (PGP, key ID: 0xD4C3B2A1).
4) Upload to a temporary presigned URL with TTL 72h and notify you.

Query recipe examples (to reproduce slices):
- Admin activity for user X: WHERE actor_id = '<actor>' AND timestamp_utc >= '2027-04-01T00:00:00Z' AND timestamp_utc < '2027-06-01T00:00:00Z' ORDER BY timestamp_utc ASC
- Key rotations in May 2027: WHERE action LIKE 'sys.kms_rotate' AND timestamp_utc >= '2027-05-01T00:00:00Z'

Chain-of-custody: export job runs under service account 'audit-exporter', write-only to s3://redwood-audit-exports/acme/..., checksum computed server-side, tarball created on hardened instance, signed with our audit PGP key, and presigned URL is single-use. We'll record operator who kicked off the job in the manifest.

I'll provide the S3 path and presigned link in the next message.

- Dev
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: security-reviewer@acmehealth.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit evidence request — signed snapshots, query recipes, and handoff checklist

Sam — quick legal/compliance notes:

- We will include an explicit chain-of-custody file (chain_of_custody.txt) with timestamps (UTC), operator username, and verification steps.
- For additional assurance we can provide a notarized hash (SHA256) via our compliance partner; let us know if you need an external timestamping authority.
- Please confirm the delivery window: Marissa proposed EOD 2027-06-02; we can stretch to 2027-06-03 if your internal reviewers need extra time.

Drive folder (internal): https://drive.redwood.internal/drive/folders/1a2b3c-acme-audit-manifests

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
From: security-reviewer@acmehealth.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: compliance_ops@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit evidence request — signed snapshots, query recipes, and handoff checklist

Marissa / team — thanks for the plan. Deliverables confirmed:
- signed-snapshot-20270530.tar.gz + signed-snapshot-20270530.tar.gz.sig (PGP)
- audit-manifest-v1.json
- operator-trail-20270531.ndjson
- chain_of_custody.txt

EOD 2027-06-02 works for us; if the presigned URL TTL is 72h that is acceptable. Please include the sample query results for key rotation events and admin.create_user within the bundle.

Best,
Sam H.
Security Reviewer, Acme Health
